study_title: Short-term variability in the microbial, nano- and picoplankton dynamics during post-upwelling season at a fixed sampling point in St Helena Bay
description: The diversity and functionality of the organisms in the 10-0.2 µm size range was studied at a fixed-point sampling site in St Helena Bay during the end of upwelling season.
